title: Doctor names the Landlock ABI 9 requirement and the Ubuntu 26.04 kernel fix
description: With the host Landlock ABI stubbed to 8, doctor prints a FAIL landlock line naming ABI 8, the required ABI 9 and the Ubuntu 26.04 fix (sudo apt install linux-image-oem-7.3); with ABI 9 it prints PASS. The README prerequisites name the Landlock ABI 9 requirement and the same fix.

steps.name: doctor landlock line and README prerequisite
